scope: Hypothetical mechanics and train-terminal electrical study using a historical LRT-2 mass convention. Not an actual route or calibrated fleet prediction.
units: SI: m, s, kg, N, W, J

sensitivity.scope: Declared hypothetical one-at-a-time electrical stresses on the same route and policy; not measured uncertainty or operational savings. Regenerative sweeps use a separate acceptance=1 reference so zero baseline acceptance cannot mask their effects.

mass_kg.basis: 160100 + 826 * 65; occupancy and per-person mass are scenario conventions

rotating_mass_kg.basis: 0.10 times historical tare mass; not measured inertia

traction_force_n.basis: Finite wheel-force stress setting; not inferred from the AW3 acceleration rating

wheel_power_w.basis: Mechanical wheel power stress setting; not aggregated motor ratings

service_brake_force_n.basis: Constant whole-train wheel-brake force; no emergency rating substitution or load-compensation law

davis_c_ns2_per_m2.basis: Whole-train coefficient in N s^2/m^2; includes aerodynamic resistance

route.basis: Synthetic 1000 m along-track profile and spatial speed limits; not a named interstation section

control.basis: Forward departure from rest; coast request from 500 m subordinate to braking limits; timeout is a feasibility bound

settings.basis: DOP853 tolerances and maximum time/distance steps; tested by refinement

sensitivity.basis: Explicit selected electrical stress values and a receptive reference, declared 2026-10-18; no statistical or fleet applicability asserted

motoring_efficiency.basis: Constant train-terminal to wheel efficiency 0.85; arbitrary example, not a fleet estimate

regenerative_efficiency.basis: Constant wheel to onboard electrical bus efficiency 0.75; arbitrary example, not a fleet estimate

auxiliary_power_w.basis: Constant 100 kW at the onboard electrical bus during simulated travel; excludes unsimulated dwell

regenerative_force_n.basis: 140 kN wheel regenerative capability; remainder of requested service braking is friction

regenerative_wheel_power_w.basis: 750 kW mechanical wheel recovery limit; not motor ratings or electrical output

regenerative_acceptance_fraction.basis: Zero disables actual regeneration including auxiliary reuse; baseline uses friction braking and imports all auxiliary demand

maximum_export_power_w.basis: 500 kW electrical terminal export ceiling, inactive at zero acceptance; no network receptivity prediction
